# Infestation Guide and Rewards

- Duchess Flame![Writer: Duchess Flame]()
- Jun 4
- 1 min read

Hello everyone,

Long time no see! 😄

Moving more than 400 guides to the new website has taken a little longer than expected, so I've set up a temporary domain in the meantime. This allows me to keep publishing new guides while making sure the older guides remain available.

The temporary site is still a work in progress, so you may come across the occasional bug, broken link, or formatting issue. If you spot anything that doesn't look right, please send me a message through the Contact tab in the Members Portal on the new site.

Thank you for your patience and support while I get everything moved across!

Duchess
